name: Premier Energy and Infrastructure Limited
about: Premier Energy and Infrastructure Limited operates in construction, housing development, and energy businesses in India. The company engages in residential and commercial development projects, as well as developing power generation infrastructural facilities. It serves manufacturing, ancillary, construction, real estate, SEZ, software, BPO, housing development, energy sector, and other industries. Premier Energy and Infrastructure Limited was formerly known as Premier Housing and Industrial Enterprises Limited and changed its name to Premier Energy and Infrastructure Limited in February 2008. Premier Energy and Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Chennai, India.
